sources.extracted_facts: Strique is an agentic AI marketing platform and AI marketing OS for growth teams. The product covers paid media, SEO, content, lifecycle, reporting, research, generative content, scheduled automations, approval gates, closed-loop measurement, reusable skills, persistent memory, and Canvas reports. Brand voice is direct, confident, operator-centric, and plain-spoken.

The keyword file maps content automation platform, content automation platforms, content marketing automation, content marketing automation platform, content marketing automation tools, and content automation to commercial product intent for Strique.

The keyword research summary was generated on 2026-06-29 for https://www.strique.io, target country United States, with 228 deduped universe rows, 150 prioritized rows, 226 Keyword Planner rows, and 0 GSC query rows in that summary artifact.

The URL inventory includes the product page, content engine in a week playbook, SEO automation blog draft path, brand context extraction blog, closing the loop blog, integrations page, and customer stories as relevant internal link targets.

Site checks show public crawl evidence, rendered browser evidence, performance evidence, keyword demand evidence, and GSC measurement coverage are available. PostHog evidence is blocked in this artifact.

The content checklist requires clear purpose, search intent match, source-backed claims, natural keyword coverage, useful headings, internal links, external references where useful, structured data, conversion fit, useful media, and cleanup of generic AI-style writing.

The existing Strique blog draft uses the agent-loop framing: audit, map, prioritize, brief, ship with approval, measure, and learn. It positions Strique around fewer handoffs and more marketing work moving from insight to outcome.
